messages:
alice (eng-release): Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in 503s from canary in eu-west-1, started ~5m ago. Canaries failing health checks.

ben (sre): saw those, also elevated KV cache miss rate and p95 token latency up ~180ms.

deploybot: [canary #487] -> status: failing health checks (3/5)
  - last-check: 2026-03-21T14:00:12Z
  - error: 503 gateway-timeout
  - rollout: 40% traffic

cara (ops): I recommend holding the rollout and pinning stable v1.12.3 for now. Need to confirm rollback vs. fix in canary. @alice can you gate? :eyes:

alice (eng-release): putting an emergency hold on the release. deploybot, pause rollout and freeze traffic shift.

deploybot: action: pause-rollout executed by alice (eng-release) at 2026-03-21T14:01:05Z

dave (pm): What's the impact if we rollback the canary to v1.12.2? Any data loss risk?

ben (sre): rollback is read-only change on routing; no data migration. Risk: brief 200-500ms increase while connections drain. It should clear the 503s if issue is introduced in 1.12.3.

alice (eng-release): quick triage note: new kernel patch in runtime kernels selected for 1.12.3 changed attention-kernel fallback path. Suspect regression under long prompt tails.

cara (ops): ops checklist to rollback canary:
- @ben: run drain script on canary nodes
- @alice: pin release to v1.12.2 in release-config
- @deploybot: execute canary-rollback when told
- monitor p95 & 5xx for 20m post-rollback

ben (sre): running drain on canary nodes now: `./tools/drain-nodes --cluster eu-west-1 --nodes canary-487`

ben (sre): drain complete, connections at 0. Initiating traffic swap candidate.

alice (eng-release): I updated release-config: pinned version = v1.12.2, rollout.paused = true. Commits: ops/release-pins#452.

deploybot: queued action: canary-rollback -> target-version: v1.12.2

cara (ops): deploying rollback in 1m. I want a staged rollback: 40% -> 20% -> 0% over 6 minutes. Watch metrics and call stop if errors worsen.

deploybot: executing staged-rollback steps:
```
step 1: traffic 40%->20% (t+00:30)
step 2: traffic 20%->0%  (t+03:30)
```

ben (sre): p95 dropping back to baseline after step 2. 5xx rate trending down.

alice (eng-release): stop. confirm full rollback complete?

deploybot: canary rollback completed at 2026-03-21T14:11:09Z. Final state: canary=0% traffic, stable v1.12.2 serving.

cara (ops): good. we'll keep rollout paused until research confirms kernel fallback fix. Scheduling follow-up release window for 2026-03-22 10:00 UTC.

dave (pm): please add a short blurb to release notes: "rolled back v1.12.3 canary in eu-west-1 due to runtime regression; rolling forward paused pending kernel fix." I'll notify affected customers.

alice (eng-release): tagging eng-runtime for root cause: @marco @li. Also opening postmortem ticket: infra/pm-rca#778.

ben (sre): final checks: infra alerting suppressed for canary to avoid noisy pages, retention window set to 2h.

cara (ops): summary checklist (done): [pause rollout, drain nodes, rollback canary, pin stable, schedule next window, open RCA ticket]. Moving thread to resolved once postmortem created. :white_check_mark:

alice (eng-release): thanks everyone. I'll follow up with timeline and rollback metrics in the ticket.
